scenes.say: When should you actually do threat modeling? Is it just a one-time thing, or do you need to revisit it?

scenes.label: Early
scenes.sub: Start threat modeling before you write code.
scenes.say: The best time to start is before you write any code. Get ahead of threats right from the design phase.
You should also revisit threat modeling when you hit major milestones, make big changes, add features, or bring in outside services.

scenes.title: Adding a Payment Provider
scenes.say: For example, if your team adds a third-party payment provider, that's the perfect time to run another threat modeling session.

scenes.question: Is threat modeling a one-time task?
scenes.wrong: Yes, just do it at the start.
scenes.right: No, repeat it with each big change or feature.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: thinking threat modeling is a one-time checkbox. In interviews, always say it's an ongoing process.
